conditions: 4.5 V, 50 pF logic tables and 100 pF flash read timing. Zero minimum contamination delays. Flash capacitance applies at 25 C. Hold reset for at least 100 us after valid flash supply; the test fixture waits an additional 101 us before normal startup.
scope: AL1 staged datapath with eight private-output PLCC32 flash devices replacing the obsolete M27C322. AL1 remains a separate historical timing candidate. Physical programming, supply startup, shared DATA, clock/reset and PCB qualification remain open.
